# Arthur Sabintsev

> Physicist, engineer, and two-time founder. COO of Modern Intelligence (Sovereign: onboard targeting for unmanned systems). Previously co-founder & CEO of Grove (wound down 2026), the team behind Pocket Network. Contact: arthur.sabintsev@gmail.com.

## About
Arthur Ariel Sabintsev is a physicist turned engineer turned founder (Washington DC–Baltimore). He started experimental nuclear physics research at Jefferson Lab, then left a fully funded PhD because he wanted to build, not publish. He is COO of [Modern Intelligence](https://modernintelligence.ai). The product is **Sovereign**: onboard targeting software that manufacturers and integrators install on UAVs, USVs, UUVs, and other unmanned vehicles. It runs on the vehicle’s computer — detect, classify, and track from onboard cameras, keep identity when the picture breaks up, terminal guidance into impact — and keeps working when GPS is out and the radio is jammed (GNSS-denied / EW). Previously he co-founded [Grove](https://grove.city) (wound down 2026) and built [Pocket Network](https://pocket.network) into a premier decentralized infrastructure protocol ($18M raised, trillion+ API requests, $1B+ market cap, still running). Grove’s last chapter was x402 agentic micropayments. Writes on [Substack](https://artsabintsev.substack.com). Full bio: [llms-full.txt](https://sabintsev.com/llms-full.txt).
